text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: prod-serving errors spike immediately after today's canary rollout to us-east-1 reserved pool. Observed rate: 25% 5xx across /v1/generate. Auto-escalating to on-call.

deploy-bot: Deploy job 2026-03-15_09:10 finished. Post-deploy healthchecks: failing (canary). Rolling back disabled fraction set to 0.2 -> 0.5.

kevin: seeing 502s, looks like KMS decrypt errors in logs. stack traces mention 'DecryptError: access denied'.

tara: @mira can you confirm if the KMS key rotation went through for the dedicated cluster this morning?

mira: I rotated the key at 05:30 but only updated the env var in the deployment template for hosted clusters, not the dedicated pools. my bad.

sre-ops: Confirming error from pods: 
```
2026-03-15T09:11:22Z ERROR auth: KMS request failed, status=403, body: {"message":"access denied for key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789:key/xxxxx"}
```

product-elaine: Customers hitting 5xx on generation — which tenants are impacted? any high-ARR ones?

kevin: early list: tenant-alpha, beta-proto, 3 internal test repos. Alpha uses dedicated pools -> likely impacted.

mira: since env var pointing to new KMS alias is missing from dedicated deployment, decryption fails for model keys. We should toggle the feature-flag rollout kill-switch and start rollback.

tara: Agree. First step: flip feature flag to kill new encryption-at-deploy feature for dedicated-pools. Command: `ffctl set prod encryption-deploy-enable false --scope dedicated-pools`

kevin: Doing it now.

kevin: :white_check_mark: `ffctl` reply: flag toggled. Confirming clients pick up change — traffic should route to legacy decryption path.

sre-ops: Flag took effect for 90% of requests, errors dropping to 3xx/2xx for canaries, but some pods still failing with KMS 403 due to cached keys.

mira: We'll perform a targeted rollback of the canary batch. Rollback command: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-serving --to-revision=1202 --selector=canary=true`

kevin: Executed rollback on two canary nodes in us-east-1.

deploy-bot: Rollback job started, pods terminating.

sre-ops: Post-rollback metrics: 5xx down from 25% -> 2.1% across region. Latency stable. No new deploys scheduled.

product-elaine: Notifying affected customers via status page. Draft status: "Partial disruption to generation in us-east-1 dedicated pool; mitigation ongoing."

mira: I'll open a follow-up runbook item to ensure KMS alias update is applied across all deployment templates and to add a pre-deploy check for key binding.

tara: Good. Also need postmortem and action items: pre-deploy checklist for env var sync, add a gating job that validates KMS key IAM permissions for each target cluster, and a canary health rule for KMS 403 spikes.

kevin: Logged incident in ops tracker: INC-2026-301. Assigning to me and mira for RCA.

product-elaine: Will coordinate customer comms. Any ETA on full recovery?

sre-ops: Full recovery confirmed at 09:28 UTC after rollback and flag flip; will monitor for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and assigned. Handoff: @tara off-call in 12m, @mira taking follow-up.

mira: I'll take ownership of the postmortem. Adding owners and timeline.

kevin: thumbs up. One more action -- add a pre-deploy hook that runs `aws kms get-key-policy` against all target keys; fail deploy on 403.

sre-ops: Noted. I'll open the PR for the pre-deploy hook and add the check to our deploy pipeline.

product-elaine: Thanks team. I'll update status page to note mitigation complete and that we are investigating root cause and next steps.

mira: final note: we should rotate back to previous KMS alias only after templates are fixed; delaying rotation until changes merged.

kevin: ending thread, will update INC-2026-301 with timeline and logs.
